evaluation_source: raw Kaggle postings, deterministic 1000-row capped sample
candidate_selection: Up to 50 first eligible postings in deterministic seed order; eligibility requires a bid decision for at least one synthetic persona.
limitations: Client preferences and reply/hire outcomes are synthetic deterministic rules, not real client responses.
Kaggle job postings are not labeled gold data for bid/skip or job risk.
The candidate pool is a deterministic hash-ordered sample capped at 1000 when the raw CSV is available, not a population sample.
The best-fitting eligible synthetic persona is selected per posting; this is not a user-persona choice study.
All three synthetic personas and their authored synthetic portfolio items are fictional.
